Job Description Summary We’re seeking a Software Engineer to contribute to the design and development of web based applications using C# react technologies. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities In This Role, You Will Contribute , design, and development of RESTful APIs and microservices using .NET, ASP.NET Core (Web API, MVC), and Entity Framework Understanding of engineering best practices: SOLID principles, design patterns, code reviews, technical standards, and documentation Build front-end experiences using JavaScript/TypeScript with ReactJS Own end-to-end delivery: requirements, design, implementation, automated testing (unit, integration, UI), performance, and deployment Design for reliability, scalability, and security in AWS; containerize and ship services with Docker Work across data stores (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle), including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning Implement and improve observability (logging, monitoring, alerting) and drive operational excellence Integrate AI/ML capabilities where appropriate to enhance product features and developer productivity Ensure secure development practices including SAST/DAST and remediation of findings Mentor and coach engineers; lead technical initiatives and collaborate with product, UX, and stakeholders Must-have Qualifications Deep knowledge in C# .NET Strong RESTful API and microservices design and development Proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript Experience with modern front-end frameworks of ReactJS Solid grasp of SOLID principles, design patterns, and microservices architecture Strong SQL skills across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle Automation experience: unit, integration, and UI test frameworks Cloud experience with AWS/Azure Proven ability to lead initiatives and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions Nice to have Monitoring and logging tools: Splunk, Prometheus, ELK Stack DevOps/CI/CD tools: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, JFrog Artifactory, Groovy Load/performance testing (e.g., JMeter) Security best practices in SAST and DAST Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Experience working independently in fast-paced, cross-functional environments Practical AI skill set (e.g., integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications) Education Qualification Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with advanced experience with 2 to 5 Years. Desired Characteristics Technical Expertise Master's Degree/ PHD in Computer Science Experience with Windows and Unix / Linux based programming Experience working on software projects in the Energy domain (Energy Management, Oil & Gas, Power & Water) Certified Scrum Master and/or Product Owner Personal Attributes Strong oral and written communication skills Strong interpersonal skills Effective team building and problem solving abilities Persists to completion, especially in the face of overwhelming odds and setbacks. We're looking for a Senior Al Engineer This role is Office Based, Hyderabad Office Al Engineer – India This role is Office Based, Hyderabad Office Cornerstone OnDemand is looking for a motivated AI Engineer to join our Workforce Intelligence team. You'll work on an AI-powered assistant that helps managers and HR leaders understand their teams — surfacing skill gaps, career pathways, and organizational insights through natural-language conversations backed by LLMs and real-time analytics. In this role, you'll build and ship features end-to-end across our backend and React/TypeScript frontend, working closely with data science, product, and platform engineering. In this role, you will… Build and own backend features — design, implementation, testing, code review, and production monitoring. Work on our LLM integration layer: streaming AI responses, prompt engineering, structured output parsing, and response validation. Contribute to our RAG and semantic search architecture — hybrid vector search, caching strategies, and data ingestion pipelines. Build rich, interactive frontend experiences in React/TypeScript that render AI-generated content in real time. Improve our NL-to-SQL pipeline that translates natural-language questions into validated analytics queries. Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and cross-team collaborations. You’ve Got What It Takes If You Have… 3–5 years of experience building production backend services in any major language (Java, Python, Go, etc.). Working experience with TypeScript and React, or a strong willingness to work full-stack. Solid understanding of REST API design, distributed systems, and service-oriented architecture. Experience integrating LLMs into production systems — prompt design, streaming responses, or structured output handling. Experience with AWS services and containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes). Strong engineering fundamentals: you care about test coverage, code review quality, and observable, maintainable systems. Extra dose of awesome if you have… Familiarity with vector databases or semantic search systems (Weaviate, Pinecone, pgvector, etc.). Experience with reactive or async programming patterns (WebFlux, SSE streaming, etc.). Exposure to analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, or similar). Familiarity with Redis for caching, session state, or pub/sub. Experience with monorepo tooling (Nx, Turborepo, etc.). Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or AI agent patterns Our Culture Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today. Who We Are Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million+ users in 180+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high-performing, future-ready organizations and people today.
